description: Official LaTeX template for the Learning on Graphs (LoG) Conference 2024, based on the NeurIPS-derived log_2024 style file. Provides a single-column one-inch-margin letter-paper layout with review/preprint/eatrack modes, anonymized double-blind submission support with line numbers, running-title headers, a boxed title bar with conference notice footer, and numeric citations via natbib (or optional biblatex), based on the article document class extended with the log_2024 style package.
